opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Creation Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small businesses and local shops looking to enhance their online presence through engaging short-form video content.
opportunity.customer_problem: Many small businesses struggle to create eye-catching video content that resonates with their audience on platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts due to a lack of time or expertise.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a comprehensive content creation package that includes scriptwriting, video editing, and caption development tailored specifically for short-form videos, enabling small businesses to effectively showcase their products and services.
deliverables: Three short-form video scripts (up to 60 seconds each)
Social media strategy document including posting schedule and engagement tips
opportunity.next_action: Create a service landing page outlining the package details and process for interested customers.
